verdict.rationale: Filtering installs and script runs to a subset of workspace packages is a fair question for a package manager that supports workspaces, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack only states that uv supports Cargo-style workspaces. It does not document per-package filtering for installs or runs, nor any way to select only the packages affected by a change. General workspace support is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
